title: Patient-requested Schedule II partial fill
rule_summary: A Schedule II prescription may be partially filled at the patient or prescriber request when state law permits, with the remaining portion dispensed no later than 30 days after the prescription was written unless a shorter applicable limit controls.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply patient request requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing patient request with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
